device.name: AM-Bench PressButton (free end-effector, absolute PID pose)

facts.text: BaseEnv is a DirectRLEnv subclass and holds the shared simulation lifecycle around one robot profile and control pipeline
PressButton extends BaseEnv
PressButton-Am-EE-Abs-PID-Direct-v0 is registered with entry_point press_button_env:PressButton and env_cfg_entry_point press_button_env_cfg:PressButtonEnvEEAbsPIDCfg
register_env calls gym.register(id=task_id, entry_point=entry_point, disable_env_checker=True, ...)
For ABSOLUTE_EE_POSE the control pipeline's action_dim returns 8
The pipeline reads the action position from action[:, :3] and the quaternion from action[:, 3:7], and adds the scene env origins to the position
The end-effector pipeline passes action[:, -1] to compute_gripper_targets
The gripper command is clamped to -1..1 and mapped as -1 closed and +1 open onto the ordered gripper joint targets

The observation for one environment is ee_pos (3), ee_quat (4), ee_lin_vel (3), ee_ang_vel (3), base_pos (3), base_quat (4), base_lin_vel (3), base_ang_vel (3), gripper_width (1), button_pressed (1) and goal_pos (3)
The observation is returned wrapped as {'policy': [one dict per environment]}; arm_joint_pos and arm_joint_vel are added only when the robot profile has arm joints
The base observation space is a gymnasium Dict of float32 Boxes: positions and velocities are unbounded, quaternions are bounded to -1..1 and gripper_width is 0..inf
The PressButton observation space adds button_pressed as a 0..1 Box of one element and goal_pos as an unbounded three-element Box
The task succeeds when the button plunger joint position is at least button_pressed_threshold
The plunger slide joint travel is 0.0 (unpressed) to 0.01 (fully pressed) and success uses the 0.004 threshold
The PressButton reward is always zeros, whatever the state
The episode is truncated when episode_length_buf reaches max_episode_length - 1
The task's episode_length_s is 20
The simulation timestep is 1/120 s and decimation is 1
BaseEnv sets self.dt = cfg.sim.dt * cfg.decimation
The free end-effector robot starts at position (0.0, 0.0, 1.0) with the identity quaternion and its two finger joints at 0.001 each
The free end-effector profile names ee_link as its control body, base body and end-effector body
The wall is at (2.0, 0.0, 1.0)
The wall default size is (0.1, 2.0, 2.0)
The button is placed on the wall surface, offset by half the wall thickness in front of the wall
Each reset randomizes the wall x and y by -0.2..0.2 and its pitch by -0.2..0.2 rad, and the button position on the wall by -0.3..0.3 in y and z
AM-Bench requires a native Linux host, a discrete NVIDIA GPU and Isaac Sim 5.1 with Python 3.11

determinism.notes: the upstream reset reseeds the environment's event RNG and the physics is stepped in lockstep; the package's fake seeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1, so one seed and one action sequence repeat its state hashes.  The fake was not compared with the Isaac Lab environment, and GPU physics determinism was not exercised

gaps: the fake backend is kinematic: it moves the end effector toward the commanded absolute pose and models the button press geometrically; it has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, collision response, actuator, sensor or noise model, so it is an F0 stand-in for an F1 environment and was not compared with Isaac Lab

the action-space bounds are not declared in the clone: the config declares only the dimension (base_env_cfg.py:47) and Isaac Lab builds the Gym Box outside the clone; the fake publishes an unbounded Box of eight values, so the runtime has no per-element action bound
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, one tick is one 1/120 s physics step (decimation 1), and the episode truncates after the 20 s episode_length_s expressed in those steps

the fake returns the per-environment observation dictionary directly, while PressButton._get_observations wraps it in {'policy': [dict]} (press_button_env.py:99-106); the bridge therefore publishes the eleven fields without the policy wrapper

the fake randomizes only the button position; the upstream reset also randomizes the wall pose and the button scale through Isaac Lab event terms (press_button_env_cfg.py:43-98), whose RNG and GPU determinism were not run
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against hardware; snapshot and restore are not offered because the environment exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
